description: Measured in fz-t93.23 (scratch t93_23/probe_a.diff, report.md): replace_held in crates/fz-engine/src/deps.rs removes every previous held use from the reverse index and then re-inserts the new ones. Diffing previous against next touches only what changed: -30M +-15M (-0.25%) on the distiller at 82a6fcd7a, md5 identical, and all suites green together with lever (e). A held-use membership check on StandingWaits is a linear scan in the probe and needs a set or sorted form. Re-measure after fz-t93.7 lands; the step tickets change how many reads are handed over.
